body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Twenty 20 introduced its wearable camcorder 'VholdR during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. Encased with aluminum, it works just fine even in poor weather conditions according to the company. If you attach it to a helmet, for instance, you can be still in motion while capturing all dynamic scenes. It is easy to use with a simple touch of a button.
The company launched an accompanying social networking website 'www.VholdR.com' where users can upload their videos and share with other people.
